reference: She finished wrapping the last lollipop and reached for the ribbon.
sk: Skončila s balením posledného lízatka a siahla po stužke.
cz: Skončila s balením posledního lízátka a sáhla po stuze.
acceptable: She finished wrapping {up |}the last {lollipop|lolly} and reached for the ribbon.

mistakes.text: She finished to wrap the last lollipop and reached for the ribbon.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Finish” is always followed by a Gerund (-ing): “finished wrapping”.

mistakes.text: She finished with wrapping the last lollipop and reached for the ribbon.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „finish“ nepatrí „with“, Gerund ide priamo: „finished wrapping“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „finish“ nepatří „with“, Gerund jde přímo: „finished wrapping“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Don't use “with” after “finish”; the Gerund follows directly: “finished wrapping”.

mistakes.text: She finished wrapping the last lollipop and reached {after|to} the ribbon.
She stopped wrapping the last lollipop and reached for the ribbon.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Stopped“ znamená prestať aj uprostred; dokončenie vyjadruje „finished“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Stopped“ znamená přestat i uprostřed; dokončení vyjadřuje „finished“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Stopped” doesn't mean the job was completed; “finished” does.
